messages:
Priya K.: Quick chase on overdue items from the indexing-backlog postmortem — several remediation tasks are still open. Linking PMR: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/indexing-backlog-2026. I'm consolidating owners + ETAs here. Ping @Sam T., @Kelly Q.

Sam T.: I'm owner of action #89 (write-path retry fix). Patch ready but CI flakes on qa-suite prevent merge. Rerunning CI now, ETA EOD 2026-03-28 if green. PR: https://git.redwood/services/indexer/pulls/212

Kelly Q.: I'm owner of action #91 (add regression test covering partial write). I have test changes in branch but need a small infra sandbox to reproduce the flaky behavior consistently. Can eng-infra spin up a sandbox with 3 small indexer nodes? @eng-infra-lead

eng-infra-lead: We can provision a sandbox. Please file an infra request with the sizing and retention window. Linking infra request form: https://redwood-internal/infra/requests. If you paste the req link here I'll prioritize it.

ops-bot: Reminder: action #89 assigned to Sam T. was due 2026-03-20 and remains open.

Priya K.: Thanks. I filed the infra request: https://redwood-internal/infra/reqs/req-887. Escalating to eng-infra leads for faster turnaround. Adjusted tracker entry: https://redwood-internal/ai-tracker/pmr-611 (target moved to 2026-03-28).

Sam T.: CI rerun output (failures below):
```
[2026-03-24T14:12:03Z] build start
[2026-03-24T14:18:21Z] test: write_path_integration_test FAILED (timeout)
[2026-03-24T14:18:22Z] stderr: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
[2026-03-24T14:18:22Z] build status: unstable
```
I reproduced the timeout locally against prod-like config and narrowed root cause to the retry backoff not resetting. Patch fixes backoff and adds additional logging.

Kelly Q.: Sandbox up (req-887) — curious if you want me to run the branch there and validate flake before merging?

Sam T.: Yes please. Running tests now on sandbox req-887. Will paste run link when done.

eng-infra-lead: Sandbox provisioned: https://redwood-internal/infra/sandboxes/req-887. Note: ephemeral, will be torn down after 72h. I've assigned DRI: @eng-infra-lead.

ops-bot: Update: action #91 (Kelly Q.) marked resolved at 2026-03-25T08:14:09Z.

Sam T.: Sandbox run passed. CI green in sandbox environment. Merge queued; will merge once I sync with release window. Merge PR: https://git.redwood/services/indexer/pulls/212/merge. Maintenance ticket for prod run: https://redwood-internal/maint/mt-765.

Priya K.: Great progress. Final request: after the prod maintenance completes, please paste the maintenance run logs + merge commit hash into the PMR and mark the PMR remediated in the tracker. I'll do a final follow-up Friday and close the PMR follow-up loop. Thanks all.

Sam T.: Merge commit hash: d4f7e2b. Will attach run logs to PMR after mt-765 completes. :thumbsup:
